columns.description: Snapshot identifier that starts one membership island, a run of sightings with no complete observation proving absence between them.

columns.description: Always add, meaning earlier complete absence and later presence bound an entry onto an editorial, algorithmic or chart list, with full-list extent corroborated for head streams.

columns.description: UTC time of the observation proving this event, using the absence observation for a removal rather than the unknown exact change time.

columns.name: platform_track_id
columns.description: Track identifier on the platform, null for an item representing a release rather than a track.

columns.name: position
columns.description: One-based item position at the event sighting, or the last sighting before a removal.

columns.name: previous_position
columns.description: One-based position in the previous complete observation at a unique time within this membership island, null when no comparison exists.

columns.name: entered_after
columns.description: UTC time of the last complete observation proving absence before this membership island, null when the entry has no known lower bound.

columns.name: first_observed_at
columns.description: UTC time of the first sighting in this membership island, giving the inclusive upper bound of a bounded entry.

columns.name: removed_after
columns.description: UTC time of the last complete sighting before a proven removal, null when the island has no complete presence proof or no later absence.

columns.name: removed_by
columns.description: UTC time of the first complete observation proving absence after this membership island, null when no such observation exists.

columns.name: is_baseline
columns.description: True when the island begins at the stream's first complete observation at a unique time, which proves presence but cannot date an add.

columns.name: uncertainty_hours
columns.description: Hours between the two observations bounding this entry, removal or move, null for an entry with no known earlier absence.

columns.name: snapshot_id
columns.description: Identifier of the observation proving the event, including the absence snapshot for a removal.

columns.description: Distinct songs with an artist-stage reading in the served current list. Open the list for evidence.

columns.name: list_songs
columns.description: Distinct songs across current movers, early signals and arrivals in this list. Open the list for evidence.

columns.name: chart_week
columns.description: Latest observed Hot 100 week at or before the bound day; null without a read. Open mart_chart_history.

columns.name: keyed_entries
columns.description: Hot 100 positions with a song key in chart_week; null without a read. Open mart_chart_history.

columns.name: chart_entries
columns.description: Hot 100 positions observed in chart_week, out of 100; null without a read. Open mart_chart_history.

columns.name: object_key
columns.description: Kind-prefixed object identity, such as song:apple:123.

columns.name: context
columns.description: JSON object with the route identity, platform, display credit and available artwork identity.

columns.name: aliases
columns.description: JSON array of distinct identity aliases, including every copy of a movement group.

columns.name: chart
columns.description: shazam:<type>:<country>[:<city>], as the chart's page path names it.

columns.name: chart_type
columns.description: top-200 (country), top-50 (city) or discovery.

columns.name: country
columns.description: ISO country code from shazam_markets. Worldwide and unknown markets are null. Open chart for the original slug.

columns.name: chart_date
columns.description: The chart's own date, from its CSV.

columns.name: position
columns.description: The rank the CSV and the page both print for this row.

columns.name: apple_primary_artist_id
columns.description: The Apple artist id of the row's one artist link; on a collaboration row, the primary artist only.

columns.name: artist_text
columns.description: The credit as the CSV prints it. Strict identity does not match names. Open the movement rules for provisional successor matching.

columns.name: multi_artist_credit
columns.description: The printed credit names more than one artist (a comma or an ampersand), so the row's artist id covers only its primary artist.

columns.name: isrc
columns.description: The page's ISRC where it carries one (the video-highlight songs), else the resolved track identity's.

columns.name: mb_recording_gid
columns.description: The MusicBrainz recording, where the Apple song id resolves in track identity.

columns.name: confidence
columns.description: Confidence of the selected recording_method on a zero-to-one scale; null when no recording is resolved.

columns.name: alias_key
columns.description: Alias key.

columns.name: song_key
columns.description: Song key.

columns.name: platform
columns.description: Platform.

columns.name: platform_track_id
columns.description: Platform track id.

columns.name: resolved
columns.description: True when a recording is known.

columns.name: song_key
columns.description: Strict identity key to look up.

columns.name: cluster_key
columns.description: Current provisional movement group.

columns.name: representative_song_key
columns.description: Song key carried by the current movement row.

columns.name: cluster_methods
columns.description: JSON array of the matching rules used by the group.

columns.name: learning_eligible
columns.description: True when every source permits derivative learning.

columns.name: resale_permitted
columns.description: True when every source permits resale.

columns.name: source_keys
columns.description: JSON array of every source behind the group.

columns.name: song_key
columns.description: Song key.

columns.name: title_text
columns.description: Title text.

columns.name: artist_text
columns.description: Artist text.

columns.name: day
columns.description: UTC calendar day.

columns.name: editorial_adds
columns.description: Distinct list entries; add counts one, entered_head counts 0.5; baseline excluded.

columns.name: algorithmic_adds
columns.description: Distinct list entries; add counts one, entered_head counts 0.5; baseline excluded.

columns.name: removes
columns.description: Distinct lists removing the song.

columns.name: playlist_followers
columns.description: Follower exposure as of this day; lists count once.

columns.name: list_count
columns.description: Distinct observed lists.

columns.name: shazam_cities
columns.description: Distinct observed city charts.

columns.name: shazam_countries
columns.description: Distinct observed countries.

columns.name: shazam_charts
columns.description: Distinct observed charts.

columns.name: shazam_new_entries
columns.description: First chart appearances with at least 26 observed days in the 28-day window. Count each song once per chart. Null means no chart has enough history.

columns.name: best_position
columns.description: Best observed position on this day.

columns.name: shazam_best_position
columns.description: Best observed position on this day.

columns.name: stream_rate
columns.description: Provider daily increment, without read-interval scaling. Only changed nonnegative counters 20 to 28 hours apart with no collection gap qualify.

columns.name: playlists_observed
columns.description: A playlist collection or membership is present, including zero events.

columns.name: shazam_observed
columns.description: Shazam charts are collected on this day, including a song absent from those charts.

columns.name: streams_observed
columns.description: A counter value is collected on this day, including unchanged counts.

columns.name: stream_interval_hours
columns.description: Longest contributing counter interval in hours.

columns.name: billboard_position
columns.description: Best Hot 100 position for this movement group on the published chart date. Null means no keyed observation.

columns.name: billboard_weeks_on_chart
columns.description: Provider weeks on chart for the best-position entry. Open mart_chart_history for the source row.

columns.name: billboard_debut
columns.description: True only for a proven first group week after a complete previous chart. Null means unknown or no keyed observation.

columns.name: rank
columns.description: Position inside its movement list. Places lists order by chart_spread_gain first; then score, emerging artists first in new_entries, list reach tier, markets, entry time and a fixed hash of day and song key.

columns.name: day
columns.description: Bound daily cycle day for the current table.

columns.name: song_key
columns.description: Song key.

columns.name: title_text
columns.description: Title text.

columns.name: artist_text
columns.description: Artist text.

columns.name: momentum_score
columns.description: Positive weighted sum of cume_dist percentiles inside the song's movement list. Equal values share the fraction at or below them; a singleton gets one. Open score_parts for evidence.

columns.name: score_parts
columns.description: JSON parts with component, value, weight, percentile and the component's window_days.

columns.name: coverage
columns.description: Coverage.

columns.name: reason_rule
columns.description: Reason rule.

columns.name: evidence
columns.description: Source row locators with captured input builds. cluster_confidence is measured precision, the lowest merge-rule Wilson 95% lower bound; open the cluster audit.

columns.name: ranking_build
columns.description: Ranking build.

columns.name: window_days
columns.description: Comparison window in UTC days; it grows with observed history to seven.

columns.name: chart_spread_gain
columns.description: New country markets on tracked chart lists or Shazam charts. It ranks signal lists first and never joins the two-family score, because it overlaps playlists and Shazam.

columns.name: list_reach_tier
columns.description: Best entered list tier; new_entries reads editorial and new-music lists only. One is widest; four is unclassified. See playlist_reach_tiers.

columns.name: market_count
columns.description: Distinct entered country markets; global and unknown are excluded.

columns.name: last_entered_at
columns.description: Most recent qualifying entry observation.

columns.name: movement_list
columns.description: new_entries: new songs by emerging, developing or unknown-stage artists. established_entries: new songs by established artists. catalog_entries: catalog waking up. unplaced: unknown age and no new-music list in the window, so no movement view reads it. Lists never mix.

columns.name: age_class
columns.description: new when the age proxy is this year or last; catalog when older; unknown without a proxy. A proxy, never a release date. Open age_basis for its source.

columns.name: age_basis
columns.description: isrc_year: the year code in the ISRC, which a reissue can make newer, never older. apple_id_band: the Apple song id range. none: no proxy.

columns.name: artist_stage

columns.name: artist_stage_basis
columns.description: Source of artist_stage. musicbrainz_catalog: release group counts and first release years read from the MusicBrainz mirror. none: artist_stage is unknown.

messages.sandbox_account_refused: This login is not a standard individual analyst or explorer account. Inspect its memberships with psql \du <login>; use a separate individual login.
messages.sandbox_acl_alert: Sandbox grants exceed the allowed sharing scope. Freeze the login and inspect its grants with the operator sandbox status command.
messages.sandbox_acl_refused: Sandbox access cannot be delegated or granted to runtime roles. Share SELECT with the allowed human group without WITH GRANT OPTION.
messages.sandbox_archive_blocked: Other objects depend on this sandbox. Notify the listed owners and remove or transfer their dependencies, then run archive again.
messages.sandbox_archive_failed: Archive failed; the login stays disabled and data is kept. Inspect the archive manifest and rerun archive with a new destination.
messages.sandbox_frozen: New objects are blocked while the sandbox is frozen. Delete unused tables, run mdp warehouse sandbox status, and ask the operator to unfreeze a manual hold.
messages.sandbox_handle_invalid: A handle uses 1–48 lowercase letters, digits or underscores, starts with a letter, and is not ro. Choose a handle such as demo.
messages.sandbox_missing: This login has no owned sandbox. Ask an operator to run ops/fly/postgres/analyst-add.sh <handle>, then reconnect.
messages.sandbox_object_invalid: The object name must use lowercase SQL letters, digits and underscores. Choose a name such as chart_draft.
messages.sandbox_owner_conflict: This sandbox belongs to another login. Choose another handle, or ask an operator to inspect it with mdp warehouse sandbox status and archive the stale schema before reuse.
messages.sandbox_quota_warning: Sandbox storage is at least 80 percent full. Run mdp warehouse sandbox status and remove unused tables before creating more.
messages.sandbox_snapshot_failed: The snapshot was not published. Check MDP_ANALYST_URL (in R, reconnect with mdp_connect()), choose a readable schema, and rerun with a new output path.
messages.sandbox_stamp_denied: Build stamps need a readable relation. Choose a readable entry in catalog.relations and rerun the snapshot.
messages.sandbox_status_failed: Sandbox status is unavailable. Reconnect with MDP_ANALYST_URL or ask an operator to run mdp warehouse sandbox status --all.
messages.sandbox_view_refused: A persistent sandbox view or SQL routine can block production schema changes. Save a table with CREATE TABLE sandbox_<handle>.<name> AS SELECT instead, or lift a view over a served mart.
messages.sandbox_write_failed: The sandbox write failed. Choose a new name or use overwrite = TRUE in mdp_write() for your own table; for a view, check its columns and save from a served mart.
messages.workbench_permission_denied: The workbench role cannot read this relation. Use the safe copy when offered and rerun. Otherwise open Explorer and choose a permitted global input, or ask an operator to restore analyst access.
messages.workbench_query_failed: The warehouse could not run this query. Check the relation and column names in the catalog, then rerun.
messages.workbench_statement_timeout: This query exceeded the statement timeout. Filter earlier or read fewer rows, then rerun; use a local snapshot for longer analysis.
